mapper.sql: so.*, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, o.id as o_id, o.name as o_name, u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.real_name as u_real_name
sales_order so LEFT JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sales_opportunity o ON so.opportunity_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON so.create_user_id = u.id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ORDER BY so.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sales_order SET payment_status = #{paymentStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM sales_order WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as amount FROM sales_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT c.type, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) as amount FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.type
SELECT p.type, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) as amount FROM sales_order o JOIN order_product op ON o.id = op.order_id JOIN product p ON op.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.type
